key_findings: Duvelisib prevented paclitaxel-induced mechanical hyperalgesia in male and female rodents.
Duvelisib prevented paclitaxel-induced TRPV1 sensitization, PI3K/Akt upregulation and CD68+ cell increase in DRG, and restored inhibitory control in spinal dorsal horn.
